guidance.repair: handle the synchronization or configured commit result; map failure to an explicit uncertain outcome, quarantine, or a propagated error instead of discarding it
observe an explicit synchronization or configured adapter result; Write::flush() only drains user-space buffers and is not durable-persistence evidence

after a failed synchronization, rewrite from the source of truth, reopen or replace the handle, quarantine, or reconcile before observing durability again; a same-handle retry does not prove earlier bytes reached storage

non_claims: These checks cover selected source shapes inside consumer-declared boundary functions only; they do not prove filesystem, device, or hardware durability.
Passing these checks does not prove that sync_all, sync_data, a configured commit, or an adapter observation succeeded.
The checks do not analyze aliasing, interprocedural control flow, runtime ordering, or macro-expanded synchronization.
repair_options: rewrite from the source of truth
